ambient_events: The slew ring turns a few degrees and stops. Nobody is in the cab.
The hook comes down to the water, hangs there, and starts back up.
Something heavy settles inside a container and goes quiet.
Wash off the basin slaps the fenders and runs back down the face of the quay.
description: Poured hardstanding to the water's edge, with rubber fenders bolted down the face of it. The crane on it is nothing like the gantries in the Yards — one sealed white shell on a slew ring, a flat boom out over the water, and a hook on a wire. It does not look like it needs anybody.
name: Basin Quay
